CONSUMER PRICE INDEX - OCTOBER 2026

BLS did not collect survey data for October 2025 because of a lapse in appropriations. For most CPI series, BLS could
not publish October 2025 indexes. As a result, BLS cannot publish 12-month percent changes for October 2026 for indexes
where October 2025 data are unavailable.
